summary: HPS Corporate Capital Solutions Fund, a non-listed BDC, filed an 8-K reporting preliminary results of its completed issuer tender offer for up to 5% of outstanding shares, which expired September 4, 2026. Approximately 946,847 shares, or about 1.9% of shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026, were validly tendered and not withdrawn, well below the 5% cap, so no proration is expected. The purchase price per share will equal NAV per share as of September 30, 2026, with final results and payment to follow. Watch for final NAV-based pricing and any subsequent repurchase activity.
